2607.07467.title: SpaCellAgent: A Self-Evolving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Trajectory Analysis
2607.07467.paper_summary: Spatial and Single-cell transcriptomics are transformative in deciphering cellular dynamics. As the fundamental paradigm for reconstructing cell developmental paths, trajectory inference (TI) is critical. However, existing methods require extensive manual intervention and proficiency in heterogeneous tools, posing a significant barrier to efficient TI analysis. To bridge this gap, we propose SpaCellAgent, an autonomous large language model (LLM) multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end spatiotemporal analysis and narrative generation. SpaCellAgent utilizes a multi-agent architecture for strategic workflow planning, a dynamic tool-orchestration engine for adaptive algorithm selection, and a self-evolution module that iteratively refines performance through feedback. We evaluate SpaCellAgent on six heterogeneous datasets encompassing complex temporal developmental trajectories, diverse sequencing platforms, and spatially-resolved tissue architectures. SpaCellAgent consistently demonstrates over 40\% improvement in analytical efficiency while maintaining expert-aligned performance. By converting natural language specifications into optimized analytical workflows and fully automating the pipeline, SpaCellAgent democratizes advanced spatiotemporal modeling and establishes a scalable, agent-driven paradigm for computational biology. The code and materials are available at https://github.com/LittleXH-shw/SpaCellAgent.
2607.07467.paper_summary_zh: 空間和單細胞轉錄組學在解碼細胞動態方面具有變革性。作為重建細胞發展路徑的基本範式，軌跡推斷（TI）至關重要。然而，現有方法需要大量手動干預和對異質工具的熟練掌握，這對高效的TI分析構成了重大障礙。為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了SpaCellAgent，一個自動化的大型語言模型（LLM）多代理框架，能夠自動化端到端的時空分析和敘事生成。SpaCellAgent利用多代理架構進行戰略工作流程規劃，動態工具編排引擎進行自適應算法選擇，以及一個自我演進模塊通過反饋迭代優化性能。我們在六個異質數據集上評估了SpaCellAgent，這些數據集涵蓋了複雜的時間發展軌跡、多樣的測序平台和空間解析的組織結構。SpaCellAgent在分析效率上始終表現出超過40\%的改善，同時保持與專家一致的性能。通過將自然語言規範轉換為優化的分析工作流程並完全自動化管道，SpaCellAgent使先進的時空建模民主化，並建立了一個可擴展的、以代理驅動的計算生物學範式。代碼和材料可在 https://github.com/LittleXH-shw/SpaCellAgent 獲得。
